name: marketing-rotating-text
title: Rotating Text
description: Original animated headline text that cycles through a list of words in place, in three distinct motion styles.
useWhen: Original animated headline text that cycles through a list of words in place, in three distinct motion styles.
avoidWhen: Avoid rotating text when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Rotating Text uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
